In the mater between  Parle Products Pvt Ltd & Anr ... Pla  Versus

Future Consumer Ltd & Ors ...Respond Mr Virag Tulzapurkar,Senior Advocate, with Hiren Kamod, Shephali Nishin Shrikhande, Aditya Chitale & Avinash Belge, i/b RKD Mormare Legal Services LLP, for the Plaintifss Mr Ashish Kamat,
with Megha Chandra & Madhu Gadodia, i/b Naik Naik & Co, for Applicant /Defendants Noss 1 &2s Mormare Date: 2021.03.23 10:49:20 +0530

CORAM: G.S. PATEL, J DATED: 22nd March 2021 PC:-
1.
Mr Kamat's application is for leave to destroy the undisputed biscuits while retaining the samples of their disputed wrappers or packaging.
There can be no objection to this.
It is also a question of health and food safety standards.
The Defendants will be at liberty 22nd March 2021 14-IAL-7223-2021 IN IAL-4133-2020.DOC to destroy the seized biscuits.
This is to be done in the presence of the Court Receiver's representative with prior notice of at least 48 hours.
2. The Receiver will retain not more than six sample wrappers of each product for future use (and also Parle use) in this Interim Application and Suit.
Future Consumer Ltd.And Anr vs Parle Products Pvt Ltd.

1 3. Mr Kamat and Mr Tulzapurkar also agree that a similar order of destruction can be made in respect of similar products lying in other locations.
There is a letter dated 2nd February 2021 which sets out the stocks at other locations.
4. The Interim Application is disposed of in these terms.
5. This is of course without prejudice to the rival contentions.
6. This order will be digitally signed by the Private Secretary/ Personal Assistant of this Court.
All concerned will act on production of a digitally signed copy of this order.
(G. S. PATEL, J) 22nd March 2021 Future Consumer Ltd.And Anr vs Parle Products Pvt Ltd.
